description: For handyman repair, this inspection checklist records diagnostic boundary, repair approach, parts, protection, estimated labor, exclusions, and restoration expectations. Its supporting evidence includes existing-condition photos, measurements, model data, test results, material receipts, and completed-repair photos.

subtitle: Handyman Repair Inspection Checklist: small-repair intake, estimate, and work control using repair location, diagnostic boundary, and existing-condition photos.
title: Handyman Repair Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during small-repair intake, estimate, and work control when the handyman repair record must identify repair location, fixture or finish, reported defect, dimensions, access, utilities, and customer-supplied materials. Complete the applicable handoff for functional verification, cleanup, customer acceptance, open referral, material warranty, and invoice handoff.
